text.body: oṃ tatsadbrahmaṇe namaḥ atha devalasmṛtiḥ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ atha prāyaścittavarṇanam sindhu tīre sukhāsīnaṃ devalaṃ munisattamam sametya munayaḥ sarve idaṃ vacanamabruvan ||1|| bhagavanmlecchanītā hi kathaṃ śuddhimavāpnuyuḥ brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrāścaivānu pūrvaśaḥ ||2|| kathaṃ snānaṃ kathaṃ śaucaṃ prāyaścittaṃ kathaṃ bhavet kimācārā bhaveyuste tadācakṣva savistaram ||3|| devala uvāca triśaṅkuṃ varjayeddeśaṃ sarvaṃ dvādaśayojanam uttareṇa mahānadyā dakṣiṇena tu kīkaṭam ||4|| prāyaścittaṃ pravakṣyāmi vistareṇa maharṣayaḥ ||5|| mṛtasūte tu dāsīnāṃ patnīnāṃ cānulominām svāmitulyaṃ bhavecchaucaṃ mṛte svāmini yaunikam ||6|| apeyaṃ yena saṃpītamabhakṣyaṃ cāpi bhakṣitam mlecchairnītena viperaṇa agamyāgamanaṃ kṛtam ||7|| tasya śuddhiṃ pravakṣyāmi yāvadekaṃ tu vatsaram cāndrāyaṇaṃ tu viprasya saparākaṃ prakīrtitam ||8|| parākamekaṃ kṣatrasya pādakṛccheraṇa saṃyutam parākārdhaṃ tu vaiśyasya śūdrasya dinapañcakam ||9|| nakhalomavihīnānāṃ prāyaścittaṃ pradāpayet caturṇāmapi varṇānāmanyathā'śuddhirasti hi ||10|| prāyaścittavihīnaṃ tu yadā teṣāṃ kalevaram kartavyastatra saṃskāro me khalādaṇḍavarjitaḥ ||11|| mlecchairnītena śūdrairvā hārite daṇḍame khale saṃskārapramukhaṃ tasya sarvaṃ kāryaṃ yathāvidhi ||12|| saṃskārānte ca viprāṇāṃ dānaṃ dhenuśca dakṣiṇā dātavyaṃ śuddhamicchadbhiraśvagobhūmikāñcanam ||13|| tadā'sau tu kuṭumbānāṃ paṅktiṃ prāpnoti nānyathā svabhāyāṃ ca yathānyāyaṃ gacchanne va viśudhyati ||14|| atha saṃvatsarādūrdhvaṃ mlecchairnīto yadā bhavet prāyaścitte tu saṃcīrṇe gaṅgā snānena śudhyati ||15|| sindhu sauvīrasaurāṣṭraṃ tathā pratyantavāsinaḥ kaliṅgakauṅkaṇānvaṅgāngatvā saṃskāramarhati ||16|| balāddāsīkṛtā ye ca mlecchacāṇḍāladasyubhiḥ aśubhaṃ kāritāḥ karma gavādiprāṇihiṃsanam ||17|| ucchiṣṭamārjanaṃ caiva tathā tasyaiva bhojanam kharoṣṭraviḍvarāhāṇāmāmiṣasya ca bhakṣaṇam ||18|| tatstrīṇāṃ ca tathā saṅgaṃ tābhiśca saha bhojanam māsoṣite dvijātau tu prājāpatyaṃ viśodhanam ||19|| cāndrāyaṇaṃ tvāhitāgneḥ parākastvatha vā bhavet cāndrāyaṇaṃ parākaṃ ca caretsaṃvatsaroṣitaḥ ||20|| saṃvatsaroṣitaḥ śūdro māsārdhaṃ yāvakaṃ pibet māsamātroṣitaḥ śūdraḥ kṛcchrapādena śudhyati ||21|| ūrdhvaṃ saṃvatsarātkalpyaṃ prāyaścittaṃ dvijottamaiḥ saṃvatsaraiścaturbhiśca tadbhāvamadhigacchati ||22|| hrāso na vidyate yasya prāyaścittaṃ durātmanaḥ guhyakakṣaśirobhrūṇāṃ kartavyaṃ keśavāpanam ||23|| prāyaścittaṃ samārabhya prāyaścittaṃ tu kārayet snānaṃ trikālaṃ kurvīta dhautavāsā jitendriyaḥ ||24|| kuśahastaḥ satyavattaktā devalena hyudāhṛtam vatsaraṃ vatsarārdhaṃ vā māsaṃmāsārdhameva vā ||25|| balānmlecchaistu yo nītastasya śuddhistu kīdṛśī saṃvatsaroṣite śūdre śuddhiścāndrāyaṇena tu ||26|| parākaṃ vatsarārdhe ca parākārdhaṃ trimāsike māsike pādakṛcchraśca nakharomavivarjitaḥ ||27|| pādonaṃ kṣatriyasyottaktamardhaṃ vaiśyasya dāpayet prāyaścittaṃ dvijasyottaktaṃ pādaṃ śūdrasya dāpayet ||28|| prāyaścittāvasāne tu dogdhrī gaurdakṣiṇā matā tathā'sau tu kuṭubānte hyupaviṣṭo na duṣyati ||29|| aśītiryasya varṣāṇi bālo vā'pyūnaṣoḍaśaḥ prāyaścittārdhamarhanti striyo rogiṇa eva ca ||30|| ūnai kādaśavarṣa sya pañcavarṣā tparasya ca prāyaścittaṃ caredbhrātā pitā vā'nyo'pi vardhitā ||31|| svayaṃ vrataṃ caretsarva manyathā naiva śudhyati tilahomaṃ prakurvīta japaṃ kuryādatandritaḥ ||32|| saṃlāpasparśaniḥśvāsasahayānāsanāśanāt yājanādhyāpanādyaunātpāpaṃ saṃkramate nṛṇām ||33|| yājanaṃ yonisaṃbandhaṃ svādhyāyaṃ sahabhojanam kṛtvā sadyaḥ patatyeva patitena na saṃśayaḥ ||34|| saṃvatsareṇa patati patitena sahā''caran yājanāsanayajñādi kurvāṇaḥ sārvakāmikam ||35|| ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi prāyaścittamidaṃ śubham strīṇāṃ mlecchaiśca nītānāṃ balātsaṃveśane kvacit ||36|| brāhmaṇī kṣatriyā vaiśyā śūdrā nītā yadā'ntyajaiḥ brāhmaṇyāḥ kīdṛśaṃ nyāyyaṃ prāyaścittaṃ vidhīyate ||37|| brāhmaṇī bhojayenmlecchamabhakṣyaṃ bhakṣayedyadi parākeṇa tataḥ śuddhiḥ pādenottaratottarān ||38|| na kṛtaṃ maithunaṃ tābhirabhakṣyaṃ naiva bhakṣitam śuddhistadā trirātreṇa mlecchānne naiva bhakṣite ||39|| rajasvalā yadā spṛṣṭā mlecchenānyena vā punaḥ trirātramuṣitā snātvā pañcagavyena śudhyati ||40|| spṛṣṭvā rajasvalā'nyonyaṃ brāhmaṇī kṣatriyā tathā trirātreṇa viśuddhiḥ syāddevalasya vaco yathā ||41|| spṛṣṭvā rajasvalā'nyonyaṃ brāhmaṇī śūdrajā tathā pañcarātraṃ nirāhārā pañcagavyena śudhyati ||42|| brāhmaṇyanaśanaṃ kuryātkṣatriyā snānamācaret sacailaṃ vaiśyajātīnāṃ naktaṃ śūdre vinirdiśet ||43|| mlecchānnaṃ mlecchasaṃsparśo mlecchena saha saṃsthitiḥ vatsaraṃ vatsarādūrdhvaṃ trirātreṇa viśudhyati ||44|| mlecchairhṛtānāṃ caurairvā kāntāreṣu pravāsinām bhuktvā bhakṣyamabhakṣyaṃ vā kṣudhārtena bhayena vā ||45|| punaḥ prāpya svakaṃ deśaṃ cāturvarṇyasya niṣkṛtiḥ kṛcchramekaṃ caredviprastadardhaṃ kṣatriyaścaret pādonaṃ ca caredvaiśyaḥ śūdraḥ pādena śudhyati ||46|| gṛhītā strī balādeva mlecchaigurvīkṛtā yadi gurvīna śuddhimāpnoti trirātreṇetarā śuciḥ ||47|| yoṣā garbhaṃ vidhatte yā mlecchātkāmādakāmataḥ brāhmaṇī kṣatriyā vaiśyā śūdrā varṇetarā ca yā ||48|| abhakṣyabhakṣaṇaṃ kuryāttasyāḥ śuddhiḥ kathaṃ bhavet kṛcchraṃ sāṃtapanaṃ śuddhirghṛtairyoneśca pācanam ||49|| asavarṇena yo garbhaḥ strīṇāṃ yonau niṣicyate aśuddhā sā bhavennārī yāvacchalyaṃ na muñcati ||50|| viniḥsṛte tataḥ śalye rajaso vā'pi darśane tadā sā śudhyate nārī vimalaṃ kāñcanaṃ yathā ||51|| sa garbho dīyate'nyasmai svayaṃ grāhyo na karhicit svajātau vajayedyasmātsaṃkaraḥ syādato'nyathā ||52|| gṛhīto yo balānmlecchaiḥ pañca ṣaṭ sapta vā samāḥ daśādi viṃśatiṃ yāvattasya śuddhirvidhīyate ||53|| prājāpatyadvayaṃ tasya śuddhireṣā vidhīyate ataḥ paraṃ nāsti śuddhiḥ kṛcchrameva sahoṣite ||54|| mlecchaiḥ sahoṣito yastu pañcaprabhṛti viṃśatiḥ varṣāṇi śuddhireṣoktā tasya cāndrāyaṇadvayam ||55|| kakṣāguhyaśiraḥśmaśrubhralomaparikṛntanamū prāhṛtya pāṇipādānāṃ nakhaloma tataḥ śuciḥ ||56|| yo dātuṃ na vijānāti prāyaścittaṃ dvijottamaḥ śuddhiṃ dadāti nānyasmai tadaśuddheḥ sa bhojanam ||57|| sabhāyāṃ sparśane caiva mlecchena saha saṃviśet kuryātsnānaṃ sacailaṃ tu dinamekamabhojanam ||58|| mātā mlecchatvamāgacchetpitaro vā kathaṃcana asūtakaṃ ca naṣṭasya devalasya vaco yathā ||59|| mātaraṃ ca parityajaya pitaraṃ ca tathā sutaḥ tataḥ pitāmahaṃ caiva śeṣapiṇḍaṃ tu nirvapet ||60|| strīṇāṃ caiva tu śūdrāṇāṃ patitānāṃ tathaiva ca pañcagavyaṃ na dātavyaṃ dātavyaṃ mantravarjitam ||61|| varuṇo devatā mūtre gomaye havyavāhanaḥ somaḥ kṣīre dadhni vāyurghṛte ravirudāhṛtaḥ ||62|| gomūtraṃ tāmravarṇāyāḥ śvetāyāścai va gomayam payaḥ kāñcanavarṇāyā nīlāyāścāpi gordadhi ||63|| ghṛtaṃ vai kṛṣṇavarṇāyā vibhattiktavarṇagocarā udakaṃ sarvavarṇaṃ syātkasya varṇo na gṛhyate ||64|| ṣaṇmātrikaṃ tu gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ ca kuśodakam trimātrikaṃ ghṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi syāddaśamātrikam ||65|| vrate tu sarvavarṇānāṃ pañcagavyaṃ tu saṃkhyayā prāyaścittaṃ yathoktaṃ tu dātavyaṃ brahmavādibhiḥ ||66|| anyathā dāpayedyastu prāyaścittī bhavedidvajaḥ ||67|| kapilāyāśca gordugdhvā dhāroṣṇaṃ yaḥ payaḥ pibet eṣa vyāsakṛtaḥ kṛcchraḥ śvapākamapi śodhayet ||68|| tilahomaṃ prakurvīta japaṃ kuryādatandritaḥ viṣṇo rarāṭamantreṇa prāyaścittī viśudhyati ||69|| bahunā'tra kimuktena tilahomo vidhīyate tilāndattvā tilānbhuktvā kuvītāghanivāraṇam ||70|| saṃpādayanti yadviprāḥ snānaṃ tīrthaphalaṃ tapaḥ saṃpādī kramate pāpaṃ tasya saṃpadyate phalam ||71|| prāyaścittaṃ samāyātaṃ yathoktaṃ devalena tu itareṣāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca nānyathā vākyamarhatha ||72|| suvarṇadānaṃ godānaṃ bhūmidānaṃ gavāhnikam viprebhyaḥ saṃprayaccheta prāyaścittī viśudhyati ||73|| pañcāhānsahavāse na saṃbhāṣaṇasahāśanaiḥ saṃprāśya pañcagavyaṃ tu dānaṃ dattvā viśudhyati ||74|| ekadvitricatuḥsaṃkhyānvatsarānsaṃvasedyadi mlecchavāsaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhaḥ kramato dravyayogataḥ ||75|| ekāhena tu gomūtraṃ vyahenaiva tu gomayam tryahātkṣīreṇa saṃyuktaṃ caturthe dadhimiśritam ||76|| pañcame ghṛtasaṃpūrṇaṃ pañcagavyaṃ pradāpayet pañcasaptadaśāhāni pañcadaśācca viṃśatiḥ ||77|| saṃvāsaṃ ca pravakṣyāmi dehaśuddhiṃ dvijanmanām pañcāhaṃ pañcagavyaṃ syātpādakṛcchraṃ daśāhike ||78|| parākaṃ pañcadaśabhirviṃśe'tikṛcchrameva ca udaraṃ praviśedyasya pañcagavyaṃ vidhānataḥ ||79|| yatkiṃcidduṣkṛtaṃ tasya sarvaṃ naśyati dehinaḥ pañca saptāṣṭa daśa vā dvādaśāho'pi viṃśatiḥ mlecchairnītasya viprasya pañcagavyaṃ viśodhanam ||80|| pañcagavyaṃ ca gokṣīraṃ dadhi mūtraṃ ghṛtaṃ payaḥ prāśyāpare'hnyupavasetkṛcchraṃ sāṃtapanaṃ caret ||81|| pṛthaksāṃtapanaṃ dravyaiḥ ṣaḍahaḥ sopavāsakaḥ saptāhena tu kṛcchro'yaṃ mahāsāṃtapanaḥ smṛtam ||82|| parṇodumbararājīvavilvapatrakuśodakaiḥ pratyekaṃ pratyahaṃ pītaiḥ pūrṇakṛcchra udāhṛtaḥ ||83|| taptakṣīraghṛtāmbūnāmekaikaṃ pratyahaṃ pibet ekarātropavāsaśca taptakṛcchrastu pāvanaḥ ||84|| ekabhaktena naktena tathaivāyācitena tu upavāsena caikena pādakṛcchra udāhṛtaḥ ||85|| kṛcchrātikṛcchraḥ payasā divasānekaviṃśatim dvādaśāhopavāsena parākaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ||86|| piṇyākaśākatakrāmbusaktūnāṃ prativāsaram ekarātropavāsaśca kṛcchraḥ saumyaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||87|| eṣāṃ trirātramabhyāsādekaikasya yathākramam tulāpuruṣa ityeṣa jñeyaḥ pañcadaśāhikaḥ ||88|| tithi vṛddhyā caretpiṇḍāñchukle śiyaṇḍasaṃmitān ekaikaṃ hrāsayetpiṇḍānkṛcchracāndrāyaṇaṃ caret ||89|| yathākathaṃcitpiṇḍānāṃ catvāriṃśacchatadvayam iti devalakṛtaṃ dharmaśāstraṃ prakīrtitam ||90||
